description: Configure macOS System Settings for a focused presentation environment. Apply these five changes: (1) enable Dark appearance globally, (2) move the Dock to the left edge of the screen, (3) enable Dock automatic hide-and-show, (4) shrink the Dock icon size to the slider's smallest setting (tilesize at or below 32 pixels), and (5) change the menu bar clock to display time in 24-hour format. You have full access to the System Settings app. All five changes must persist after you finish — the verifier reads the macOS `defaults` domains (NSGlobalDomain, com.apple.dock, com.apple.menuextra.clock) that System Settings writes to.

metadata.occupation: IT administrators / presentation operators / lab Mac stewards
